text:
maya: Quick pulse — final SEO / redirect / schema pass for Wed go-live. I’ll do a sweep tomorrow morning but need owners asap for these items so nothing blocks launch. TL;DR: redirects, canonical, schema for webinar + FAQ, internal link anchors, keyword h1/h2 checks, utm/tracking.

omar: I can take redirects. Will run a redirect simulation on staging today. Posting what I plan to push: 
```
# nginx redirect examples
rewrite ^/old-product(/.*)?$ /product-new$1 permanent;
rewrite ^/pricing-old$ /pricing permanent;
```
I’ll also generate a redirect map csv for ops.

leigh: I’ll own structured data and the on-page keyword headers. Plan: add WebinarEvent + FAQPage on landing, and JSON-LD for speakers. Sharing snippet to review: 
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebinarEvent","name":"Redwood Inference Launch Webinar","startDate":"2024-06-12T16:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar-launch"}
```
Note: keep FAQ answers short (<300 chars) to avoid microdata bloat.

sam: I’ll do internal linking and anchor sweep across blog + docs. Priority anchor list: product features -> benchmarks -> pricing. Also updating CTAs on the webinar page to match messaging variations (v1/v2). Will push PRs for content edits by EOD.

maya: Great — Omar please add the redirect csv to the ops ticket and ping eng-infra for a deploy window (we prefer pre-traffic 02:00 UTC). Leigh can you add schema to the staging page and tag me when ready for QA? Sam, do you need any canonical changes from eng?

omar: Yep — csv will go in OPS-4123. I’ll request deploy window for 02:00 UTC Wed. Quick Q: do we canonicalize /webinar and /webinar?utm_source=... to /webinar (strip utm) at edge?

leigh: Yes, canonical should point to clean URL (no utm). We'll also add <link rel="canonical" href="https://redwood.ai/webinar" /> in head. Make sure the CDN doesn't inject query variants as separate pages.

sam: For internal links, I’ll update anchors to use full path without querystrings. If eng needs a template change to avoid querystring canonicalization issues, flag me and I’ll coordinate.

launchbot: deploy-scheduler: New deploy request created by @omar for OPS-4123 at 2024-06-12 02:00 UTC.

maya: Checklist for QA (quick):
- Redirect map uploaded to OPS ticket (omar)
- Staging schema + JSON-LD present (leigh)
- Canonical tags cleaned (leigh / eng)
- Internal links and CTAs updated (sam)
- UTM tracking + GA events validated (growth)
- 301s smoke test post-deploy (omar + eng-sre)
Reply with owner or 'ok' so I can lock the preflight doc.

omar: ok (redirects owner)

leigh: ok (schema + canon)

sam: ok (internal links + CTAs)

maya: Awesome. One last ask — messaging alignment: can everyone confirm the hero h1 is using the primary keyword "LLM inference platform" and that the webinar page includes the phrase "production inference" in the first 150 words? Small copy tweak but big for ranking.

leigh: I’ll verify H1 + first paragraph on staging and post screenshots in this thread.

omar: I’ll include a smoke test step to crawl the landing page after deploy and assert h1 present.

sam: Copy tweak noted — will sync with content PRs.

maya: Thanks team. If nothing else, I’ll close the preflight at 08:00 PT tomorrow. :thumbsup:
